easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other artifact creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
